# Lore Organics

> Premium organic period care. GOTS certified organic cotton pads, tampons and liners. Launching October 1st 2026 in the Netherlands and Germany.

Lore Organics designs plastic-free, GOTS certified organic cotton period care for women with high standards. We donate 1% of every sale to women's shelters and period poverty organisations from day one.

- [Home](/): Brand overview, waitlist signup and FAQ.
- [Products](/products): Organic cotton pads, tampons and liners with full material transparency.
- [Cycle Box](/cycle-box): Customisable subscription box, save up to 15%.
- [About](/about): Our mission, founders and design philosophy.
- [Sustainability](/sustainability): Materials, certifications and lifecycle.
- [Impact](/impact): How we fund period equity through every purchase.
